experiment.title: Fix SIGINT exit code propagation in relay.js
experiment.hypothesis: The child process exit handler incorrectly calculates the exit status for SIGINT. It currently returns 143 (128 + 15) but should return 130 (128 + 2).
experiment.falsifier: Running the probe_process again with the same script and args must fail with code 143 if the fix is not applied.
experiment.intendedBenefit: Correctly propagates SIGINT exit status (130) instead of 143, satisfying the relay's contract to preserve child exit codes.
